title: ASR Facet Vocabularies (facets.json)
description: The registry's hand-authored, multi-axis facet vocabularies. A profile MAY carry scope.facets: {<facet-id>: [<value-id>, ...]}; every facet id and value id it uses MUST be declared here (unknown_facet_value). Facets are registry-local by design — energy axes and mycology axes do not share one list — and orthogonal: one source may carry governance_domain AND sector AND policy_stage at once. Kept a separate file from topics.json because topics are a single-parent subject tree while facets are independent axes; like topics.json and unlike the manifest, this file is hand-curated, never regenerated. Supersedes the 0.2.0 free-string coverage.policy_states / coverage.sectors.

id.description: Facet-axis id (snake_case or kebab); the key profiles use in scope.facets.
Facet value id (kebab or snake_case); the value profiles reference in scope.facets.<facet>[].
